heroSub: 12 hand-picked Phang Nga hotels across every budget — from luxury beachfront resorts and design pool villas in Khao Lak to teak hillside villas on the Koh Yao islands, down to hostels and a guesthouse from a few hundred baht. Covering 4 key areas: Khao Lak, Koh Yao Yai, Koh Yao Noi and Phang Nga Town. From roughly ฿450–9,000+/night.
heroStats: 🏝️ 4 key areas (Khao Lak·Koh Yao Yai·Koh Yao Noi·Town)
introH2: 🏝️ Why does choosing the right area in Phang Nga matter so much?
introHtml: Phang Nga isn't a single beach — it's spread across very different areas with very different vibes and logistics. Khao Lak is a long, quiet coastline with white-sand beaches, beachfront resorts and the main gateway to the Similan Islands. Koh Yao Yai and Koh Yao Noi sit in the middle of Phang Nga Bay between Phuket and Krabi — boat access only, but they reward you with real quiet and views of limestone karsts rising out of the sea. Phang Nga Town isn't on the coast but is a cheap base for Phang Nga Bay, James Bond Island and onward travel. Many people book without checking the area, then lose hours shuttling back and forth by road or boat. This guide rounds up 12 Phang Nga hotels we've already reviewed across every tier — from luxury beachfront in Khao Lak down to hostels and a guesthouse — with real guest-review scores, a 3-site price comparison and direct booking links for each.
mrtHtml: Phang Nga has no metro. Getting around means rental car, scooter, taxi, and boat (for the Koh Yao islands and the Similans). The main gateway is Phuket Airport (HKT) — roughly 50 min to 1.5 hours to Khao Lak. Koh Yao Yai and Koh Yao Noi need a boat from Ao Po or Bang Rong (Phuket) or Ao Nang (Krabi), about 20–45 min. The areas in this guide: Khao Lak — white-sand beaches, beachfront resorts, Thap Lamu pier for the Similans · Koh Yao Yai — quiet, hillside and beachfront villas, boat-in · Koh Yao Noi — boutique stays, Phang Nga Bay views, boat plus road transfer · Phang Nga Town — base for Phang Nga Bay and James Bond Island, cheap.

entries.name: The Sarojin
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.6 · TripAdvisor 4.8/5 (2,400+ reviews · #2 in Khuk Khak)
entries.mrtTag: 📍 White Sand Beach · Khao Lak (Khuk Khak)
tags: 🍳 Breakfast cooked to order, all day
entries.addr: 60 Moo 2, Khuk Khak, Takua Pa, Khao Lak, Phang Nga
entries.storyHtml: The top score in this guide at 9.6 — The Sarojin is an adults-only luxury resort on Khao Lak's white-sand beach that many travellers rate the best stay in the area. No children under 10, so it's exceptionally quiet. Its 56 Residence-style rooms sit in gardens around old fig trees, starting at 95 sqm — several times larger than a typical 5-star room. The most-praised feature is the à la carte breakfast, cooked fresh and served from morning to evening. TripAdvisor 4.8/5 from over 2,400 reviews.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget allows, upgrade to a Pool Residence for a private garden pool. Pre-book a Pathways Spa treatment and a sea-view table at Edge. It's 1–1.5 hours from Phuket Airport — ask the resort to arrange a transfer.
pros: Every room is a spacious Residence, from 95 sqm
Quiet adults-only vibe, ideal for couples and honeymoons
À la carte breakfast cooked fresh, served morning to evening
On a wide, quiet white-sand beach with a garden infinity pool
cons: High price — best for a special trip, not an everyday stay
No children under 10; families with young kids can't stay
Far from the airport and town; you'll need a car to go out

entries.name: Santhiya Koh Yao Yai Resort & Spa
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Hillside by the bay · Koh Yao Yai (boat from Ao Po)
entries.addr: 88 Moo 7, Phru Nai, Koh Yao, Koh Yao Yai, Phang Nga
entries.storyHtml: Santhiya is the largest eco-luxury resort on Koh Yao Yai, scoring 9.5. Its signature is the teak craftsmanship across the whole resort, with rooms and villas terraced up a hillside by the bay — almost every room looks out over the Krabi–Phang Nga sea. Villas come with private filtered-seawater pools, and there's a long list of free activities: yoga, Muay Thai, kayaking, snorkelling. Access is by a mandatory resort speedboat from Ao Po, Phuket, about 20–30 min. TripAdvisor 4.5/5 from over 2,700 reviews.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget allows, upgrade to a Seawater Pool Villa for a private seawater pool. Time the speedboat to your check-in and pre-book a buggy — the hillside is steep. Reserve an Ayurvana Spa treatment on day one.
pros: Beautiful teak craftsmanship; villas have private seawater pools
Krabi–Phang Nga sea views from almost every room; very quiet
Lots of free activities: yoga, kayaking, paddleboarding, kids' club
Works well for both couples and families
cons: Mandatory speedboat in, with a per-person, per-trip fee
Resort is on a steep hill; you rely on buggies, sometimes with a wait
Food and drink prices inside the resort run fairly high

entries.name: JW Marriott Khao Lak Resort & Spa
entries.addr: 41/12 Moo 3, Khuk Khak, Takua Pa, Khao Lak, Phang Nga
entries.storyHtml: JW Marriott Khao Lak is the most-reviewed hotel in the luxury group — 1,593 Booking reviews — scoring 9.3. Its calling card is a winding lagoon pool over 2.5 km long that Pool Access rooms step straight into from the balcony. There's a water park, slides, a kids' club, and 11 dining venues, with breakfast earning particular praise. Reopened after a major renovation in late 2022. TripAdvisor 4.6/5 from over 5,000 reviews.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If swimming is the point, book a Lagoon Pool Access room. Request a room away from the kids' activity zone and the event lawn if you want quiet. Eating in the resort a lot? Price up a half-board package when you book.
pros: 2.5 km lagoon pool; Pool Access rooms step in from the balcony
A genuine family resort: water park, slides, kids' club
11 dining venues; breakfast live-counters that guests rave about
The most reviews in the luxury group — quality is well proven
cons: Food and drink prices inside the resort are high
Soundproofing between rooms isn't great
It's a large resort, not the private boutique experience

entries.name: Casa de la Flora
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.3 · 63 reviews · TripAdvisor 4.7/5 (920+ reviews) · Design Hotels™
entries.addr: 67/213 Moo 5, Khuk Khak, Takua Pa, Khao Lak, Phang Nga
entries.storyHtml: Casa de la Flora is a design resort and Member of Design Hotels™ with just 34 slate-grey cube pool villas on the Khao Lak beachfront, scoring 9.3. The hook: every villa has a private pool, no exceptions — even the entry room — which is hard to find at this price. Breakfast is à la carte, cooked fresh and served until 2pm, perfect for late risers. TripAdvisor 4.7/5 from over 920 reviews.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget allows, choose a Beachfront Pool Villa or higher so the pool faces the sea. Check the tide chart before swimming in the sea. The resort transfer costs more than a Grab/taxi — compare first.
pros: Striking cube-villa design; a Member of Design Hotels™
Every villa has a private pool, even the entry room
À la carte breakfast cooked fresh, served until 2pm
Very clean rooms; nightly turndown, free daily minibar
cons: Beach swims depend on the tide; shallow at low tide
Spa and gym are average for the price
Far from the airport; price isn't for every trip

entries.name: La Flora Khao Lak
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bang Niang Beach · Khao Lak · walk to night market
entries.addr: 59/1 Moo 5, Khuk Khak, Takua Pa, Bang Niang Beach, Khao Lak, Phang Nga
entries.storyHtml: La Flora Khao Lak is a beachfront resort on Bang Niang Beach scoring a high 9.6 at an accessible price. You wake to the sea out front, yet it's a few minutes' walk to the Bang Niang night market and restaurants. There are two lagoon pools and pool-access rooms you step into from the balcony — good for both families and couples who don't want to pay luxury rates. TripAdvisor 4.6/5 from over 920 reviews.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget allows, pick a Pool Access or Seaside Pool Access room — they step into the pool and sit nearer the beach. In-resort food is pricey, so walk to the Bang Niang night market. In high season, grab a poolside lounger early.
pros: On Bang Niang Beach; walk to the night market and restaurants
Two lagoon pools; pool-access rooms step in from the balcony
Varied buffet breakfast, both Thai and Western
Family-friendly with kids' club and kids' pool; good value
cons: In-resort food and drink cost more than places outside
Poolside loungers get claimed early in busy periods
Some garden-wing rooms feel dated; ask for a renovated one

entries.name: Cape Kudu Hotel
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.1 · 45 reviews · TripAdvisor 4.7/5 (1,120+ reviews · #4 on Koh Yao Noi)
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Tha Khao · Koh Yao Noi (boat from Phuket/Krabi)
entries.addr: 43/4 Moo 5, Tha Khao, Ko Yao Noi, Koh Yao Noi, Phang Nga
entries.storyHtml: Cape Kudu is a 5-star boutique hotel and Member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World on Koh Yao Noi, scoring 9.1. What sets it apart is its vintage, semi-colonial seafarer design — blue-and-white tones, globes, old maps. There are 56 rooms and pool villas across two pools (one reserved for adults) with quiet Phang Nga Bay views. Access is by boat from Phuket or Krabi plus a road transfer. TripAdvisor 4.7/5, ranked #4 of 15 hotels on the island.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you can stretch it, upgrade to a Pool Villa for a private pool. Pre-book the transfer from Manoh Pier. Leave buffer time on the boat, as schedules depend on weather and tides.
pros: Characterful vintage design, unlike a typical island resort
Beautiful Phang Nga Bay and karst views; very quiet
Clean, nicely decorated rooms; attentive staff
A Member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World
cons: Hard to reach: boat from Phuket/Krabi plus a road transfer
The beach out front is natural, with a clear tide
Limited dining and shops outside the hotel on the island

entries.name: Elixir Resort Koh Yao Yai
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.2 · 78 reviews · TripAdvisor 4.5/5 (830+ reviews · Travellers' Choice 2025 #2)
entries.addr: 99 Moo 3, Phru Nai, Koh Yao, Koh Yao Yai, Phang Nga
entries.storyHtml: Elixir is a 4-star boutique resort built around private beachfront villas on Koh Yao Yai, at lower rates than the island's 5-star resorts, scoring 9.2. The signature is a roughly 300 m private beach that's nearly empty, with around 40 villas spread through green gardens — more beach house than hotel room. The beachfront restaurant stands out for seafood and lobster. TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice 2025, ranked #2 on the island.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For full sea views, upgrade to a Beachfront Pool Villa. Tell the resort your flight details so they can arrange the boat-and-road transfer in advance. Check the tide chart if you want to swim in the sea.
pros: Quiet private beach, around 300 m long
Spacious villas with gardens around them — very private
Praised fresh breakfast and beachfront seafood
More affordable than 5-star resorts on the same island
cons: Remote: boat plus several road transfers to reach
Sea swimming is tide-dependent at times
Pool and some fixtures show signs of wear

entries.name: Koyao Island Resort
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.1 · 56 reviews · TripAdvisor 4.6/5 (1,048+ reviews · #6 on Koh Yao Noi)
entries.addr: 24/2 Moo 5, Ko Yao Noi, Koh Yao Noi, Phang Nga
entries.storyHtml: Koyao Island Resort places its villas on a private beach over 220 m long facing straight onto Phang Nga Bay, scoring 9.1. You step from the villa terrace onto the sand, looking out at the limestone karsts people call the James Bond view. There are 26 villas designed to blend into nature with wood and thatch, including a Panorama Tented Pool Villa with a luxe glamping feel. TripAdvisor 4.6/5, ranked #6 of 15 hotels on the island.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you can stretch it, upgrade to a Panorama Tented Pool Villa for a private pool and panoramic view. Pre-book the transfer from the pier. Bring mosquito repellent — it's a nature-side resort.
pros: Lovely private beach; full Phang Nga Bay and karst views
Quiet atmosphere, great for escaping the crowds
Natural design with local materials; good food and breakfast
Tented Pool Villa with a private pool and panoramic sea view
cons: Hard to reach: boat from Phuket/Krabi plus a road transfer
Pricey relative to villa size
Nature-side resort, so some mosquitoes and insects

entries.name: Khaolak Merlin Resort
entries.revCount: Booking 8.9 · 1,036 reviews · TripAdvisor 4.5/5 (#11 in Khao Lak)
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khao Lak Beach · Lam Kaen · ~50 min from airport
entries.addr: 7 Phetkasem Rd, Lam Kaen, Thai Mueang, Khao Lak Beach, Phang Nga
entries.storyHtml: Khaolak Merlin is a large beachfront 4-star resort in a 15-rai tropical garden with 1,036 reviews, scoring 8.9. The draw is four pools with a slide and a kids' pool, which makes it a strong pick for families with young children. The grounds are spacious and shaded — many guests say it feels like staying in a forest — fronting about 190 m of Khao Lak beach. From just ฿2,500, about 50 min from Phuket Airport. TripAdvisor 4.5/5, ranked #11 of 85 hotels in Khao Lak.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: With kids, ask for a room near the slide pool or a Pool Access room. Want to be near the beach? Request a sea-side zone at booking. In-resort dining is limited, so head out to Khao Lak's restaurants too.
pros: Four pools with a slide and a kids' pool — great for families
15-rai tropical garden on the beach; leafy and quiet
1,036 reviews — consistently popular
Good value for a beachfront 4-star resort
cons: Limited in-resort dining; the beach restaurant underwhelms
Large resort; some rooms are far from the beach and lobby
Few restaurants outside the resort; you'll need a car

entries.name: Slumber Party Surf Khao Lak Hostel
entries.revCount: Booking 8.4 · 24 reviews · Slumber Party Hostels chain
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bang Niang · Khao Lak · walk to the beach
entries.addr: 67/243, 67/245 Moo 5, Khuk Khak, Takua Pa, Bang Niang, Khao Lak, Phang Nga
entries.storyHtml: Slumber Party Surf is a social hostel in the Slumber Party Hostels chain in Bang Niang, Khao Lak, scoring 8.4. The draw isn't fancy rooms but an atmosphere designed for solo travellers to meet people the moment they walk in. There are 6- and 8-bed dorms plus private Doubles, a pool, and a Barception bar that's the social hub. It's adults-only and a short walk to Bang Niang beach. Dorm beds start in the low hundreds. It's a newer place with few public reviews, so it sits near the end of this guide.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For quieter sleep, ask for a private Double or a dorm away from the bar, and bring earplugs. Use it as a base to rent a scooter for Khao Lak-Lam Ru park or the Similan boats at Thap Lamu. Book ahead in high season.
pros: Fun social vibe; easy to meet people, great for solo travellers
Pool and bar on site; plenty of evening activities
Bang Niang location; walk to the beach and restaurants
Budget-friendly, with dorm beds in the low hundreds
cons: Noisy on party nights; light sleepers will struggle
Adults-only; not suitable for families with children
Newer property with limited public reviews

entries.name: Thap Lamu Andaman Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thap Lamu · Lam Kaen · ~1 km from Thap Lamu Pier
entries.addr: 60/111 Moo 5, Lam Kaen, Thai Mueang, Thap Lamu, Phang Nga
entries.storyHtml: Thap Lamu Andaman is a small 2-star budget stay of about 21 rooms, roughly 1 km from Thap Lamu Pier, scoring 7.8. Its one clear selling point is location — close to the main pier where speedboats and dive tours leave for the Similan and Surin Islands. It suits travellers checking in for an early-morning tour who'd rather not drive over from Khao Lak. Rooms are simple, with air-con, free Wi-Fi and parking. Public reviews are still thin, so it sits near the end of this guide.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Tell them your real check-in time ahead, as the small property isn't always staffed at the desk. Confirm the dive-tour meeting point the night before. Book ahead during the dive season (Nov–Apr).
pros: Close to Thap Lamu Pier; handy for Similan/Surin boats
Budget price, good for travellers watching their spend
Free Wi-Fi and parking; about 10 min from Khao Lak beach
cons: No pool and it's not beachfront
No breakfast; you find food around Thap Lamu
Basic property with limited public reviews

entries.name: Phang Nga Guesthouse
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phetkasem Rd · central Phang Nga Town
entries.addr: 99/1 Phetkasem Rd, Thai Chang, Mueang Phang Nga, Phang Nga
entries.storyHtml: Phang Nga Guesthouse is the cheapest stay in this guide, from just ฿450, in central Phang Nga Town, scoring 7.6 from 20 reviews. It's a small 18-room guesthouse on the main Phetkasem road, within walking distance of a 7-Eleven, local restaurants and the town market. Rooms are small but clean, with a choice of fan or air-con — a fit for budget travellers and backpackers using the town as a base for Phang Nga Bay. It sits at the end of this guide as a basic stay on a busy main road.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you sleep light, ask for a room that doesn't face the road or the side alley to avoid traffic noise. Specify air-con when booking, as the cheapest rooms are fan-only. Use it as a base for Phang Nga Bay and James Bond Island from Tha Dan pier.
pros: Central location; walk to 7-Eleven and restaurants easily
Cheapest in this guide; good value for a budget stay
Small but clean rooms; friendly staff
Private parking and a 24-hour front desk
cons: Small rooms; the building is older, some rooms feel dim
On the main road; some rooms hear traffic from morning to night
No pool and no breakfast included

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms and change with date and season. Always check live prices and compare 3 sites before booking. In High Season (November–April), especially New Year and Songkran, prices rise and rooms sell out fast — book 1–2 months ahead. During the monsoon (May–October) seas are rougher and boats to the Koh Yao islands and the Similans may be cancelled on some days, so check the forecast. Phang Nga has no metro; getting around means rental car, scooter, taxi and boat. From Phuket Airport it's roughly 50 min to 1.5 hours to Khao Lak. Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — common traveller questions about Phang Nga hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in around Phang Nga?
faq.a: It depends on your travel style. Khao Lak is a long, quiet coastline with white-sand beaches, beachfront resorts and the gateway to the Similans (The Sarojin, JW Marriott, Casa de la Flora, La Flora, Khaolak Merlin). Koh Yao Yai and Koh Yao Noi sit in Phang Nga Bay, boat access only, with real quiet and karst views (Santhiya, Elixir, Cape Kudu, Koyao Island). Phang Nga Town isn't on the coast but is a cheap base for Phang Nga Bay (Phang Nga Guesthouse). Every area needs a car or boat, so pick to suit your plans.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Phang Nga hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: guesthouses and hostels from around ฿350–700/night; beachfront and boutique 4-star resorts around ฿2,500–5,000; 5-star beachfront resorts and pool villas from around ฿6,000–9,000+. All figures are approximate starting rates for standard rooms. In High Season (Nov–Apr) prices run much higher, especially for private-pool villas.

faq.q: ❓ How do I get to Koh Yao Yai / Koh Yao Noi, and are island stays worth it?
faq.a: Neither island has an airport. You take a boat from Ao Po or Bang Rong (Phuket) or Ao Nang (Krabi), about 20–45 min, then a road transfer on the island. If your trip is about quiet, karst views and a private beach, staying on the islands (such as Santhiya, Elixir or Koyao Island) is worth it for an atmosphere Khao Lak can't match. But dining and shops outside the resorts are limited, so plan to eat in the resort and pre-book your boat-and-road transfers.

faq.q: ❓ Who is Khao Lak for, and what is there to do?
faq.a: Khao Lak is much quieter than Phuket or Krabi, suiting travellers who want a relaxed beach stay over nightlife. The draw is its long white-sand beaches and being the gateway to the Similan Islands (boats leave from Thap Lamu Pier). There's a tsunami memorial and Khao Lak-Lam Ru National Park. Plan 3–4 nights to relax in the resort and do a day of Similan diving. If you want shopping or nightlife, Khao Lak isn't the place.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Phang Nga hotel?
faq.a: On weekdays outside the tourist season, 2–4 weeks ahead is enough. But in High Season (November–April), especially New Year and Songkran, good rooms, beachfront resorts and private-pool villas sell out fast — book 1–2 months ahead or more. During the Similan dive season (Nov–Apr), stays near Thap Lamu Pier fill quickly too.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Phang Nga hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) differ by promotion period, so it's worth comparing all three before booking. Every review page in this guide has price-comparison links — that can save you hundreds to over a thousand baht per night in peak periods.
